review.error.tree_failed: Could not record the working tree (git {step} failed): {error}
review.decision.base_missing: The working tree could not be recorded as the run base; layered review will refuse this run.
review.config.agent_required: review.agent must name an agent when review.depth is not off
review.error.bad_max: max must be an integer from 0 to {maximum}
review.error.outside_repo: the file is a link that leaves the repository
review.md.check_help: Validate REVIEW.md (a missing file means defaults)
review.error.agent_failed: Review agent runs failed: all {count} finders ended without an answer.
review.error.incomplete_finders: Review incomplete: no finder answered, so nothing was reviewed.
review.error.incomplete_verifiers: Review incomplete: {answered} verifiers answered but the quorum is {quorum}, so the findings were not judged.
review.plan: Review plans up to {planned} agent runs (cap {cap}, review.max_runs_per_round); this can take a long time, so run it from a terminal or in the background
review.error.off: Layered review is off for this run: set review.depth and review.agent in the configuration before it starts
review.error.task_running: A task is running; finish it before a review round
review.error.no_base: This run has no recorded starting tree, so a review round cannot tell what it changed
review.error.over_cap: A review round would use {runs} agent runs, over the cap of {cap} (review.max_runs_per_round); nothing was run
review.guard.rounds: The run used {used} of {cap} review rounds
review.error.unknown_finding: No review finding has the id {id}
review.error.outcome: Unknown outcome "{outcome}"; use wrong, intentional or does-not-matter
review.error.dismiss_person_only: Finding {id} is Important: only a person closes it, with review dismiss in their own terminal
review.error.human_required: review dismiss needs a person at a terminal: ask the human to run it for finding {id}
review.arg.outcome: Why it is closed: wrong, intentional or does-not-matter
review.arg.reason: What the reason is, in words
review.run.help: Run one review round over the changes of the active run
review.show.help: Show the last review round and the findings still open
review.resolve.help: Close a Nit or Pre-existing finding (an Important one needs review dismiss)
review.dismiss.help: Close any review finding; human operator only (needs a terminal and a typed word)
review.gate.open_important: Cannot finish: Important review findings are still open ({ids}). Fix them or dismiss them with a reason.
review.gate.stale: Cannot finish: the working tree changed since the last review round (or none ran). Run a review round first.
review.gate.reviewer_unscored: Cannot finish: {paths} changed and no recorded comparison shows the reviewer improving on this tree. Score the change first.
